newsitem.title: UK: Scholl to sell Septivon brand to Chefaro.
newsitem.headline: Scholl to sell Septivon brand to Chefaro.

text.p: Britain's Scholl Plc said Thursday that it would sell its cleansing product brand Septivon to Chefaro Intenational BV of France for 125 million francs.
The company said it was also planning to sell its French cosmetics unit Laboratoires Valdor SA.
The Septivon business represented 10.8 percent of Scholl's 1995 consolidated operating profits, it said in a statement.
The consideration monies are being held in an escrow account pending approval by the French health ministry.
The company said the money would be reinvested in some of its key footcare and footwear brands.
